verdict.rationale: The vendor documents driverless use in any USB port and NFC tap-to-authenticate on compatible Android and iOS devices, along with passkey/WebAuthn support across the web. This implies broad OS and browser compatibility, but no published catalog of supported services or browsers appears in the evidence. Missing for 10: a published compatibility catalog of supported services, an explicit per-OS/per-browser support matrix, and independent hands-on corroboration of cross-platform behavior.

support.subject: As a power user, the key works across my operating systems and browsers, with a published compatibility catalog of supported services

citations.quote: Insert your Solo 2 into any USB port. No software or drivers required.
NFC tap-to-authenticate for compatible Android and iOS devices.
It's a USB+NFC device that protects your accounts with passkeys/WebAuthn
